text: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. 1 O God, [keep] no silence to You; do not be silent, and do not be still, O God.
For behold, Your enemies roar, and those hating You have lifted up the head.
Against Your people, they act with cunning counsel, and they take counsel together against Your treasured ones.
They say, “Come, and we shall make them disappear as a nation, and the name of Israel will not be remembered anymore.”
For, they consulted together in heart; they cut an alliance against You—
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia with those dwelling [in] Tyre.
Assyria also has joined with them; they have become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah
may You do to them as [to] Midian, as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin, at the River Kishon.
They perished at Endor; they became dung for the earth!
Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, and like Zebah, and like Zalmunna—all their princes—
who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
O my God, set them like the whirling dust, like chaff before the face of the wind!
As the fire burns a forest, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire,
so may You pursue them with Your tempest and terrify them with Your storm.
Fill their faces [with] shame, and they shall seek Your name, O YHWH.
Let them be put to shame and dismayed until forever, and may they be ashamed and perish!
And they shall know that You—Your name [is] YHWH—You alone [are] Most High over all the earth!
